title: Moraine Lake And Lake Louise Private Group Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Take one of our Private tours (6 hrs) through Banff National Park, where you can create your own itinerary and explore the spots that interest you most. Whether it's Lake Louise, the views along the Bow Valley Parkway, Peyto Lake or Moraine Lake (June 1-Oct.13), you’re in control of the day.

With your own driver, you’ll get a laid-back, personalized experience, soaking in the mountains, lakes, and wildlife at your own pace. It’s the best way to see the park your way.
